recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit and do not rename current ImagingStudy.modality for FHIR-3544. If the old QUICK example needs modernization, handle it as a separate Library/clinical-reasoning example review rather than as this ImagingStudy tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-3544 was a Published / Persuasive FHIR-core ImagingStudy change request raised against the Initial Draft and applied for DSTU1. It asked to rename top-level ImagingStudy.modality to ImagingStudy.modalityList to disambiguate it from ImagingStudy.series.modality.
initial_application: Historical commit e621d20623aabcc8c4ceddf6fc115cc185c914c0 applied the original GForge issue as [#3544], changing the old ImagingStudy spreadsheet and example XML from ImagingStudy.modality to ImagingStudy.modalityList.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-12477 explicitly superseded the naming portion of FHIR-3544 by approving a rename from modalityList back to modality while rejecting a series.modality cardinality change. Commit 7b2b64512052c9a800a59b0ac3cd2cd013659b1b applied that later change, and the combined branch already contains c116df3a4a22f3a16c1a4d6f594ad7c2f41478ef auditing FHIR-12477. Current fhir.ini lists ImagingStudy as active and maps ImagingStudy.modalityList to ImagingStudy.modality; later issues FHIR-17279 and FHIR-36120 also use the current ImagingStudy.modality name.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current active ImagingStudy StructureDefinition has ImagingStudy.modality and ImagingStudy.series.modality, so changing the current resource back to modalityList would contradict later final work-group decisions. The only current modalityList occurrences are old-version mapping metadata and an old QUICK model-definition example outside the authoritative ImagingStudy resource source.
